description: Guard (016 FR-007). A multi-line HTML comment block holds a backtick on its first line and another on its closing line; the conforming record follows the block. A renderer ends the block at its '-->' whatever backticks it holds, and per-line reading agrees, so the record is visible and the check must pass. A fix that paired across the block would disarm that '-->', and the unterminated-comment rule would hide the record.

scripts/enforcement-pack.ps1: # Fixture stub, not the kit's script. The boundary (plan D2b) asks a commit's parent tree
# one question - does its copy of this path define the check? - and this is the whole of
# the answer. A fixture that omitted it would have every commit report as pre-boundary,
# which is a green run that graded nothing.
